promotions.claim: Consumer subscriptions are runtime-driven from PostgreSQL.
Event contract versions are persisted and enforced before durable writes.
Consumer retry limits are read from the runtime subscription registry.
Aggregate ordering is guarded during durable event processing.
Consumer failures are persisted and poison events are isolated after bounded retries.
Commerce domain consumers execute concrete PostgreSQL-backed effects with idempotency.
Runtime registry APIs are the authoritative source for subscriptions and event schemas.
Durable commerce events execute JSON-schema validation at runtime.
